verdict.rationale: Alerting is a fair axis for a cloud hosting platform, but the evidence pack never documents a Fly.io feature for condition-based alerts sent by chat or email. The Slack mention concerns scoping access credentials for a bot, not platform notifications. Running Uptime Kuma on Fly is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met
